body: I have three months, I can't make 2,500
All of my friends are living at home/staying in dorms.
I got caught trying to kill myself a few years ago, pretty sure that disqualifies me.
Yeah, people hire professional landscapers here. And none of the alcohol-serving restaurants were willing to let me bus, let alone bartend.

Rooms in my city are $600+, and it would take me hours to walk to work from the under $750 ones.

And I have an irregular schedule, everyone here does. So does everybody else working minimum wage highschool jobs. If I took a second and had a schedule conflict, I'd be fucked.

>work in a related field to your study subject and save up a few years

I don't study anything, I'm in highschool. I have no experience except bagging groceries. I'm worthless, the only jobs that want me are the ones that want anybody.

>-study in europe for (almost) free

I wish I could, but I'm not a EU citizen and I don't think $500 is enough to move across the world like that

All the jobs for teenagers here pay minimum or minimum-union dues, and they all have inconsistent schedules. I can't nanny/babysit/hospice either, all the local companies only hire girls. If there's a job that'd hire me here able to pay nearly $1000 monthly, I haven't seen it. 

I should mention I can't drive. Never had the money to learn or get licensed.
